content.short: Moonimals are digital collectible arts that depict the volatility of the crypto market. The depiction is inspired by the famous crypto quote "to the moon!".
content.description: Our mission is to provide the NFT community with high quality and high effort artworks that a collector can be proud of hodling. All NFTs in our first collection (Apollo) is hand-drawn and original. We will also donate a portion of our total sales to our chosen Animal Welfare Organization.
